#besthealthinsurance #TATAAIG
Review of TATA AIG Health insurance - Tata AIG Medicare health insurance, Tata AIG Medicare Premier Medical Insurance.
TATA AIG Medicare  health insurance plan has been introduced by TATA AIG General Insurance Company. TATA AIG Medicare and Medicare Premier health policy offers a global coverage to the entire sum assured value that gives the customers a choice of availing the treatment anywhere across the globe, basis the ailment was diagnosed in India and the policyholder travels to foreign soil for the medical procedure. The basic sum assured is refunded automatically if the sum insured is exhausted during the term of the policy. Bariatric surgery to treat weight control and obesity is also covered under the health insurance policy. It also offers an accrued bonus of 50% of the sum assured for every claim free year.

TATA AIG health insurance policy covers more than 540 day-care surgeries that include maternity cover, first year vaccination expenses cover and organ donation.

It also offers cover against pre-hospitalisation and post-hospitalisation expenses, along with accident, illness, dental treatment, surgeries, and hearing aid charges.
Common Benefits under all TATA AIG Health Insurance plans
- Tax benefit under section 80D
- Lifelong renewal provided all premiums are plain regularly.
- Migrate or transfer can be done to any other insurer with other plans.
- Cashless hospitalization for  3000+ network hospitals.
- Zero sub limits on expenses covering inpatient treatment, day care expenses, domiciliary treatments and organ donor expenses.
- Sum Insured Enhancement.
- Grace Period of 30 days is available to Policyholder, but coverage will not be given for the time for which no premium has been received.
- Freelook period where one can cancel the policy within 15 days from the receipt of the policy documents.
